title: Keryx Memory Reliability P5 — Temporal, Config, Catalog, and Validation Consistency

AC1.note: src/memory/temporal.ts isCurrentAt/isValidAt is consumed by search.ts, relevant.ts, and inject.ts.

AC2.note: Temporal fixture and P5 tests cover leap day, impossible date, future validity, no bounds, and exclusive Valid-To boundary.

AC3.note: validation.ts and CLI/config tests cover status/class/query/limit/as-of and bounded actionable errors; old additive configs deep-merge.

AC4.note: loadMemoryConfig warns and strips allowAutoAccept; P4 draft-only ingest/reflection and P5 compatibility tests pass.

AC5.note: MemoryTypeConfig.template removed; all 11 MEMORY_TYPES remain registered and templates/docs reflect that.

AC6.note: memory index output is explicitly optional generated catalog; templates/docs state search scans Markdown directly.

AC7.note: memory check no longer treats absent catalog as integrity issue; P5 test passes without catalog.

AC8.note: P5 deletion test plus existing embedding delete/rebuild/no-network tests prove deterministic lexical/embedding compatibility.

AC9.note: Focused 54/0, changed 104/0, and bunx tsc --noEmit pass; P5 checklist is the only requirements-plan phase updated.
